entry.name: jit.catch~
entry.description: Transforms MSP signals into a stream of jitter matrices.

arguments.name: channels
arguments.description: The number of input signals. An inlet will be created for each channel and the output matrices will contain the data for each channel on a separate plane.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.digest: Capture and output mode
attributes.description: Four different modes are possible: in mode 0, all data since the last output is output in a one-dimensional matrix. In mode 1 the amount of buffered data that fits into a multiple of theis output in two dimensions; data not output will be saved for the next time. In these first two modes, every sample collected should be output once and only once. In mode 2 aof the most recent data is output. Mode 3 causesto behave like an oscilloscope, triggering on channelwhen the signal crossesin the direction. If the threshold has not been passed for the duration of the entire internal data buffer (100 ms), jit.catch~ reverts temporarily to mode 2 behavior and outputs the most recent data until the threshold is crossed again.
